sentences.en: Please hang up and the operator will call you back.
sentences.zh: 请挂断电话，接线员会回拨给您。

sentences.en: I hear that you yourself are quite the smooth operator.
sentences.zh: 我听说你自己也是个很会交际的人。

sentences.en: This is the operator. Which extension would you like?
sentences.zh: 这里是总机，请问您要转接到哪个分机？
